Theorem
[Finite-volume ends are standard cusps] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0210, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0211 ↗ lem:chow-iv-topological-ends-thin ↗ thm:chow-iv-thin-part-structure 1. ch31:31.44\group Hyperbolic cusps

Every topological end of a finite-volume hyperbolic manifold contains a cofinal subset isometric to a standard cusp $[0,\infty )\times \mathcal V$ with metric $dr^2+e^{-2r}g_{\rm flat}$, where $\mathcal V$ is closed and flat.
